apply_zone_weather previously wrote ClearColor only inside the volumetric-fog-with-record branch and early-returned when zone_weather.current was None, so a painted fog horizon leaked across zone lines into weatherless zones and survived the volumetric-fog toggle. Fix: added a DefaultClearColor resource that captures the app's startup backdrop in PreStartup, extracted a pure zone_clear_color(rec, volumetric_fog, daylight_smooth, default) selection function, and restructured apply_zone_weather to compute and write the desired ClearColor every frame BEFORE the no-record early return (change-detection-guarded write). Volumetric+record paints the daylight-scaled zone fog color as before; every other state (no record, wasm, DistanceFog mode) restores the captured startup default.
